Klasse ExpansionMoves

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.AbstractMoves
moveCategories.ExpansionMoves
public class ExpansionMoves extends AbstractMoves
This class is a collection of expansion moves.

These moves are used for expanding and increasing the number of controlled nodes owned by the agent. They aim to occupy neutral nodes and to fight weak enemy nodes. They help to gather information by expanding the visibility and increase the ownership bonus.

The class extends AbstractMoves and therefore has access to the shared game state and helper methods.

  • Methodendetails

    • getAsManyNodesAndFight

      public String getAsManyNodesAndFight(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, double averageFactor)
      Combines attacking and expanding move.

      This method takes Fernies from the budget calculated relatively to the average Fernies per owned node scaled by the averageFactor. With the taken Fernies, enemy nodes get attacked if possible first and then neutral nodes get occupied. Remaining Fernies are placed on the strongest node as a fallback.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      averageFactor - scaling factor applied to the average number of Fernies per owned node to determine aggressiveness
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing multiple attack and placement actions, or an empty String if no action is possible

    • getAsManyNeutralNodes

      public String getAsManyNeutralNodes(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, int perNode)
      Occupies as many visible neutral nodes as possible.

      Fixed number of Fernies placed on each neutral node, defined by the perNode parameter. If the neighbor of a neutral node is an enemy with a strength <=3, the enemy gets attacked.

      Fernies are taken from the budget, remaining Fernies are placed on the stronges owend node as a fallback move.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      perNode - number of Fernies to place on each neutral node
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the expansion and attack actions, or an empty String if no aciton is possible (edge cases)

    • putOnHiddenNode

      public String putOnHiddenNode(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Places Fernies on a neutral or owned node invisible for the enemy.

      The candidate with the greatest distance to the enemy is selected as the target node.

      A fixed part of the available Fernies budget is taken and placed on the target node. If no hidden node exists, a fallback placement strategy is applied.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the placement action, or a fallback move String if no hidden node is available

    • expandToHiddenNodes

      public String expandToHiddenNodes(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, int limit)
      Expands to nodes that are invisible for the enemy.

      Neutral and owned nodes invisible for the enemy are collected. A fixed part of the available Fernies is taken and distributed to the collected candidates that are hidden for the enemy.

      If no hidden nodes are available, a fallback move is applied.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies available
      limit - the minimum number of Fernies that must remain on a node when taking the Fernies
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the action, or a move String representing the fallback action when no hidden nodes exists
